description: Team-based collaborative todo app with workspaces, projects, tasks, assignees, due dates, and real-time WebSocket updates

tech_stack.frontend: React + Tailwind CSS + React Router + React Query
tech_stack.backend: Django 5 + Django REST Framework + Django Channels
tech_stack.realtime: WebSockets via Django Channels (in-memory channel layer for MVP)

architect: Design API contracts for all features
Define data flow including WebSocket events
ui: List all pages with routes and auth requirements
Define UI tokens and component library
backend: Define all Django REST API routes
Design Django Channels consumers for real-time
database: Design all Django models (tables, fields, types)
